name: Notes
description: Personal notes with folders, tags, full-text search, and trash management for your workspace.

tools.name: skeleton_refresh_notes
tools.description: Note statistics: total count, pinned, trash, folders, recent notes with folder.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List notes (paginated). Returns up to `limit` rows per call (max 200). If `has_more` is true, call again with `offset=offset+limit` to fetch the next page.

params_schema.description: List notes with optional filters.

limit.description: Max notes per page (1-200). Use offset to paginate.
limit.title: Limit

folder_id.description: Filter by folder — accepts folder UUID or folder name (auto-resolved).
folder_id.title: Folder Id

tags.description: Filter by tag names (AND-match: a note must have all listed tags).
tags.title: Tags

is_archived.description: Filter by archive status. None (default) = active notes only. True = archived notes only. False = explicitly active only.
is_archived.title: Is Archived

is_trashed.description: Filter by trash status. None (default) = not-trashed only. True = trashed notes only (the trash bin). Use this to count/list notes in trash.
is_trashed.title: Is Trashed

params_schema.title: ListNotesParams

NoteListItem.description: Slim SDL note entity for list results.
NoteListItem.title: NoteListItem

Ref.description:
Lightweight reference to another entity (parent/related/list-item/cross-app).

Carries ``title`` so the kernel can render/resolve without a second lookup.
Ref.title: Ref

return_schema.description:
list_notes — a REAL sdl.EntityList[NoteListItem] (items=[...], x-sdl='entity-list').
Pagination cursors carried as additive typed fields; has_more inherited from EntityList.
return_schema.title: ListNotesResult

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: Get full content of a note by ID.

params_schema.description: Target a specific note.
params_schema.title: NoteIdParams

Ref.description:
Lightweight reference to another entity (parent/related/list-item/cross-app).

Carries ``title`` so the kernel can render/resolve without a second lookup.
Ref.title: Ref

return_schema.description:
Full SDL note entity. id=note_id (UUID), title=note title, kind="note".
sdl.Bodied provides: body (content), body_format.
sdl.Categorized provides: tags.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Create a new note with title, content, tags, and optional folder.

params_schema.description:
Create a new note.

`title` and `content_text` both have safe defaults — handler-side
normalization decides what to do with empty values rather than
Pydantic rejecting the call. LLMs occasionally pass `content`,
`body`, `text` instead of `content_text` — accepted via aliases.

title.description: Note title. Field name is 'title' — never the folder name.
title.title: Title

content_text.description: Note body text. Field name in tool calls is 'content_text' — never 'content', 'body', or 'text', though those are accepted as aliases.
content_text.title: Content Text

folder_id.description: Folder UUID or folder name — auto-resolved by the handler. Pass the name directly.
folder_id.title: Folder Id

params_schema.title: CreateNoteParams

tools.name: update_note
tools.description: Update note fields (title, tags, pin) or REPLACE its content. WARNING: content_text OVERWRITES the entire body — to ADD text to an existing note use append_to_note instead.

params_schema.description: Update an existing note.
params_schema.title: UpdateNoteParams

tools.name: append_to_note
tools.description: Append text to the END of an existing note's body WITHOUT overwriting it. The text is added server-side in one atomic operation, so appending to a long note stays cheap and two appends can never overwrite each other. Use this for any 'add to note / append / допиши / добавь в заметку' request — never use update_note to add content, because update_note REPLACES the whole body.

params_schema.description: Append text to the END of an existing note's body (never overwrites).

note_id.description: Note UUID to append to. Required.
note_id.title: Note Id

content_text.description: Text to append AFTER the existing note body. The existing content is preserved; this text is added to the end. Field name is 'content_text'.
content_text.title: Content Text

params_schema.title: AppendNoteParams

Ref.description:
Lightweight reference to another entity (parent/related/list-item/cross-app).

Carries ``title`` so the kernel can render/resolve without a second lookup.
Ref.title: Ref

return_schema.description:
Full SDL note entity. id=note_id (UUID), title=note title, kind="note".
sdl.Bodied provides: body (content), body_format.
sdl.Categorized provides: tags.
return_schema.title: NoteEntity

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Full-text search across all notes (paginated). Returns up to `limit` results per call (max 50). If `has_more` is true, call again with `offset=offset+limit` to fetch the next page. Do NOT claim to have searched all notes until `has_more` is false.

params_schema.description: Full-text search.

limit.title: Limit

include_archived.description: Also search archived notes (default search skips them).

tools.name: move_notes
tools.description: Move MULTIPLE notes into the same folder at once. Pass note_ids (list of IDs) OR note_titles (list of names, auto-resolved), plus folder_id (a folder UUID or name — empty moves them to root). Use when the user wants to move 2+ notes.

params_schema.description:
Bulk move: one target folder for the whole set.

Inherits note_ids / note_titles from BulkNotesParams on purpose — title
resolution has to behave exactly like every other batch here, not almost
like it.

note_ids.description: List of note IDs to act on. Use when you already have the IDs.
note_ids.title: Note Ids

note_titles.description: List of note titles to find and act on. Auto-resolved to IDs via search.
note_titles.title: Note Titles

folder_id.description: Target folder UUID or folder name — auto-resolved. Empty string moves them to root (All Notes).
folder_id.title: Folder Id

params_schema.title: MoveNotesParams

BulkItemRow.description:
One row of a fanned-out batch.

The bulk actions that go through /notes/bulk-action get a single
affected_count back from the backend and that is genuinely all there is to
report. Move and attachment-delete have no bulk endpoint, so they issue one
request per item — and then a bare count would hide *which* ones failed.
Hence a row per item.
BulkItemRow.title: BulkItemRow

tools.name: delete_folder_with_contents

tools.name: delete_folders
tools.description: Delete MULTIPLE folders at once. Pass folder_ids (list) OR folder_names (list of names). By default notes inside are just detached (moved to root); pass with_contents=true to trash (or permanent=true to permanently delete) the notes inside each folder too. Use for bulk/multi-select folder cleanup.

params_schema.description:
Bulk-delete multiple folders by ID and/or name in one call.

Pass folder_ids when you already have them (e.g. from the GUI multi-select,

folder_names.description: List of folder names to find and delete. Auto-resolved to UUIDs.
folder_names.title: Folder Names

with_contents.description: If true, notes inside each folder are moved to trash (or permanently deleted if permanent=true) before the folder is removed. If false (default), notes are just detached (moved to root).
with_contents.title: With Contents

permanent.description: Only applies when with_contents=true: permanently delete notes instead of trashing them.
permanent.title: Permanent

params_schema.title: DeleteFoldersParams

return_schema.description: Result of a bulk delete over an explicit folder-id set.
return_schema.title: BulkDeleteFoldersResult
